column1: # The 45 VJSON_KEYED / VJSON_IDKEYS detail-hop rows — MEASURED 2026-10-06.
# This file used to say these rows' identity was "a faithful translation, but
# emitted-vs-stored has not been measured on them, and that needs egress this
# session did not have". It has now been measured, with
# audit_registry_emit.py against a pinned binary. The question it existed to
#   THE `+` COMPOSITION CARRIED OVER CORRECTLY. The five 8-part composites
#   `+` been read as `,` — keying on `aid`, the activity — each would have
#   collapsed to the few thousand distinct activities. They did not.
#   19 COLLISION verdicts total 218,769 emitted and 218,692 stored: 0.035%,
#   worst d-portal row 0.081%. Those are the upstream's own duplicates, not
# What the pass found that no amount of reasoning about id_keys would have:
#   9 FETCH_FAILED. Eight il-knesset-* rows whose OData service now 303s to an
#   HTML maintenance page, and us-courtlistener-search-recap-dockets answering
#   429. Nine registered sources storing nothing. Before this pass they stored
#   nothing SILENTLY; lib/hpengine.c now files a collector-fetch-failure record
#   for each, which is what made them legible here.
#   1 real defect, and it was not identity: us-sf-311-open311-requests emitted
#   20 and stored 15 because SF's Open311 server rate-limited both the page
#   walk and the per-record detail hop. core/hostgate.c now paces
#   mobile311.sfgov.org at 1200 ms, which took the same row from 20 records
#   across 5 pages to 90 across 19 before the quota bites again — still
#   5 SLOW: the trans-* rows above are large enough to outrun a 600 s kill.
#   Unmeasured-to-completion, not failed — the row counts are what each had

column6: note
